identity.name: The Times of Israel
identity.description: An Israeli English-language online newspaper covering Israel, the Middle East and the Jewish world, with news, analysis, blogs and opinion.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Launched in 2012 by journalist David Horovitz and American investor Seth Klarman. Registered as Zmanei Yisrael; the outlet says it has no partisan affiliation.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Founded as an independent English-language outlet with a multi-author blog platform and a broad range of Israeli voices; ownership by a private investor creates potential pressures.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via secondary references (official about page blocked or unavailable); secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates The Times of Israel Left-Center with High factual reporting; its news coverage is professional while opinion and blogs span a wider range.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is secondary and generally market-oriented without a consistent ideological programme.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Israeli national lens with strong coverage of the Jewish diaspora and Israel's international standing.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; established English-language newsroom with corrections and named reporters.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Israeli English-language coverage aimed at international and diaspora readers, combining fast news, analysis and a wide blog platform.

selectionRationale: Adds a major Israeli English-language perspective and diaspora coverage that complements global wires.

research.researchNotes: Official About page blocked the research client with 403. Founding and ownership from Wikipedia and secondary references. Feed validated. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
